attributes.dkAbstract: The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is issuing a direct final rule to update a requirement for Contracting Officers. The requirement will require the contracting officer to complete a Determination and Findings (D&F) that will be approved by the HCA for contracts with a base contract period and option periods which total in excess of five (5) years, unless otherwise prohibited by statute.
